subject: Coordination: Joint security review + procurement gating
messages:
From: Lina Torres <lina.torres@acmecloud.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jason Reed <jason.reed@acmecloud.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Request: security evidence session + procurement gating

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the team at Acme would like to move towards a formal security review before procurement signs off. Can we set up a single joint session that covers:

- High-level architecture and data flows (what leaves/stays in our VPC)
- Data handling and retention for embeddings & logs
- Encryption at rest/in transit and key management options
- SOC 2 / third-party attestations and timelines to produce evidence

Attendees we expect: myself (Security), Jason Reed (Procurement), two infra engineers (names TBA). Our preferred windows next week are Tue/Wed mornings PST (9–11am).

Attached is our updated questionnaire (acme-sec-questionnaire-v2.pdf) — we can pre-populate if helpful.

Can you confirm who from Redwood should attend (security/compliance + SE)? And any pre-reads you want us to see?

Best,
Lina
Lina Torres
Head of Security, Acme Cloud
security@acmecloud.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: security evidence session + procurement gating

Lina — thanks, this is exactly what we want to do. Suggested plan: 60-minute working session (45m discussion + 15m action items) with:

- Redwood security/compliance (Marissa) to run evidence/Q&A
- SE (Ben) for architecture and data flow diagrams
- AE (me) to coordinate procurement questions and next steps

Im attaching our security pack to help pre-answer some questionnaire items (redwood-security-pack.pdf). If Acme can highlight top 8 questions from the questionnaire ahead of time, well prioritize those in the session.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue Jun 22 09:00–10:00
- Tue Jun 22 10:30–11:30
- Wed Jun 23 09:30–10:30

Marissa — can you join one of these and advise if 60 minutes is enough? Ben — can you prepare a 10-min diagram that shows embedding flow + where logs are stored?

Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lina Torres <lina.torres@acmecloud.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 12:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: security evidence session + procurement gating

Karthik / Lina — I can cover SOC 2 scope, encryption, KMS integrations, and what artifacts we can reasonably provide during/after the call. Two asks from my side before we lock a slot:

1) Final attendee list (names + roles) so I can tailor the artifacts and avoid NDA-sensitive call-outs.
2) Highlight 5 highest-priority questionnaire items — well prepare short answers and indicate where we need follow-up.

60 minutes should be fine for a working session if we keep to the prioritized Qs. If Acme wants a longer walkthrough of architecture, we can follow up with a separate SE-led session.

Ill block both Tue 9:00 and Tue 10:30 tentatively on my calendar until we confirm.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Jason Reed <jason.reed@acmecloud.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lina Torres <lina.torres@acmecloud.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 08:19:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: security evidence session + procurement gating

Folks — Procurement constraints: we need a calendar-confirmed evidence session before we can issue a preliminary PO. Also, our legal team requires that security-sensitive answers be documented in an addendum; rapid follow-up is critical. Prefer Tue Jun 22 09:00–10:00 PST. Also, for our infra folks, only 2 engineers will join and they will be available through 10:30.

Can Ben include a short slide that highlights data residency options and an outline of enterprise/private deployment (VPC/on-prem)? That helps unblock procurement.

Thanks,
Jason Reed
Senior Manager, Procurement | Acme Cloud

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jason Reed <jason.reed@acmecloud.com>, Lina Torres <lina.torres@acmecloud.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: security evidence session + procurement gating

Jason / Lina — Ill prepare a 10–12 slide appendix focused on:
- Data residency / VPC options / Private deployments
- KMS integrations (supported providers) and HSM options
- Default log retention and how to configure retention per-customer

Confirming Tue Jun 22 09:00–10:00 PST works for Redwood. Ill keep the architecture section tight so infra engineers get the key info within 30 minutes.

Ill create the calendar invite and share a short agenda + links to artifacts.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood-security-pack.pdf (for pre-read)

From: Lina Torres <lina.torres@acmecloud.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jason Reed <jason.reed@acmecloud.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: security evidence session + procurement gating

Thanks — Tue 22 at 09:00 PST confirmed on our side. Attendees: Lina Torres (Security), Jason Reed (Procurement), Rahul Patel (Infra Engineer), Mei Wong (Infra Engineer).

Lina
Lina Torres
Head of Security, Acme Cloud
